381: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ; ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
It is the Master's will that the slanderer reaches no high spiritual state anywhere;
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
and the more anyone slanders the saints, the more the saints feel at ease. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
O Master, Your saints have Your support, and You are the saints' helper.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
Says Nanak: God keeps the saints safe, and sweeps the slanderers away. ॥4॥2॥41॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
One who washes the body outside while the mind within stays filthy loses both his places, this world and the next.
ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
Here he is gripped by lust, anger and attachment; hereafter he weeps and sobs. ॥1॥
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
The understanding that worships God is of another kind.
ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ. ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beating the snake's hole does not kill the snake; such a one stays deaf and does not hear the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ; ਭਗਤੀ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
One who gave up earning a living from Maya does not know the worth of devotion either;
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
one who takes to arguing over the Vedas and Shastras does not grasp the essence or union with God. ॥2॥
ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ. ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ; ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
As a counterfeit coin is exposed when it comes before the assayers,
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
so the Knower of hearts knows everything: how can anything be hidden from Him? ॥3॥
ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
Life here is brief, yet through falsehood, deceit and fraud a person soon dies a spiritual death.
ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ. ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ; ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
Nanak has said this as true, true, true: keep the Name in your heart and see Him dwelling there. ॥4॥3॥42॥
ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ. ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
As the devotee strives, his mind becomes pure; casting out his self-conceit, he dances.
ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
He keeps the One Lord in his mind and holds the five vices under control. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ; ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Your servant dances by singing Your praises.
ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He plays the unceasing word of praise within; that is his rebab, drum, cymbals and ankle bells. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ. ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ; ਪਾਛੈ. ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
First he awakens his own mind, then stirs longing in others.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
He repeats God's Name in his heart, then recites it aloud to all. ॥2॥
ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ; ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
With his hands he washes the feet of the holy, and puts the dust of the saints on his body.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
He gives his mind and body over to the Guru and receives the eternal treasure of the Name. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Whoever hears and beholds it with faith is rid of the pain of birth and death.
ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ. ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
Such a dance saves from hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh wakes up. ॥4॥4॥43॥
ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ. ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ; ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ. ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
The utterly low outcaste nature has become a Brahmin's, and risen from Shudra to high caste.
ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ; ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ. ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
The flame of craving that stayed hungry with all from the nether world to the sky has been quenched. ॥1॥
ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ. ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ; ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
The cat of the house, the discontented nature, has learnt another lesson: it shrinks from the mouse of worldly things.
ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ; ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has put the lion of pride under the goat of humility, and turned the dogs, the dark senses, to grazing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ. ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮੑਿਆ; ਨੀਘਰਿਆ. ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
The roof of the mind is held up without the pillars of worldly hopes, and the homeless mind has found a home.
ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ. ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ; ਥੇਵਾ. ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Without a jeweller the jewelled ornament is made, and the wondrous gem of the Name is set in it. ॥2॥
ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ; ਚੂਪੀ. ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
The complainer could never obtain justice; now, gone quiet, he has received it.
ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ; ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
The habit of glaring at others is gone; the pride that sat on rich carpets now looks spiritually dead. ॥3॥
382: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ. ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ; ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ. ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
One who says "I know" is still ignorant; one who truly knows is never hidden.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
Says Nanak: one to whom the Guru has given the nectar to drink blossoms, savouring it again and again. ॥4॥5॥44॥
ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ. ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ; ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
Cutting their bonds, God forgets their faults and keeps in mind His age-old nature;
ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ. ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ; ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
He is kind to them like mother and father and cherishes them like children. ॥1॥
The great Lord of the world keeps safe the Sikhs of the Guru.
ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ; ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Looking on them with His gracious glance, He pulls them out of the vast world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ. ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
He by whose remembrance one is freed from death and finds peace here and hereafter,
ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
repeat His Name with your tongue with every breath and morsel; let us sing His praises always. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Through loving devotion they attain the highest state; in the company of the holy their sorrows flee.
ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ, ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ; ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
They gather the pure wealth of God's Name; it does not wear away or get lost, and no fear touches it. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
At the last moment God becomes their helper and protects them here and hereafter.
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
O Nanak, His Name is the wealth I hold, my life's friend and well-wisher; I am ever a sacrifice to Him. ॥4॥6॥45॥
ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ; ਹਉ. ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
When You are my Master, what fear can there be? Apart from You, whom should I praise?
ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ. ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ; ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
When You alone are with me, I have everything; apart from You I have no other. ॥1॥
O Lord, I have seen that the world is poison.
ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ; ਮੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Protect me, my Master; may Your Name be my support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ; ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ. ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
You know all the pain of the mind; to whom else should one tell it?
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Without the Name the whole world goes mad; when the Name is found, one finds bliss. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ; ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ. ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
What is there to say, and to whom? Whatever is to be said should be said to God.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
All that happens is Your doing; our hope is always in You. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
If You give me honour, the glory is Yours; here and hereafter I meditate on You.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ; ਮੈ. ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
O God of Nanak, ever the Giver of peace, Your Name alone is my strength. ॥4॥7॥46॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
O Lord, Your Name is the water of life; only a servant of Yours has drunk this supreme taste.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ; ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
The fears and burdens of birth after birth are gone, sin is destroyed and the wandering after another is over. ॥1॥
Beholding you, I come alive spiritually;
ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O true Guru, hearing your words, my mind and body grow cool. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
By Your grace, O God, I found the Guru's company; You Yourself did this.
ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ; ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
I grasped Your feet firmly, O God, settled in stillness of mind, and Maya's hold was spent. ॥2॥
ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ; ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
O God, treasure of comforts, I took up Your imperishable Name as my mantra;
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ; ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
the true Guru gave it to me in his kindness, and my pain, distress and enmity are gone. ॥3॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
Blessed is the human body I received, through which God has joined me to Himself.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
Blessed even is the Kali age, if one sings God's praises in the company of the holy; O Nanak, the Name is the heart's support. ॥4॥8॥47॥
383: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ; ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
All that came to me came from the very first; what other knowledge can a person grasp?
ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Despite my errors and slips, the Supreme Lord God forgave me, His child. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
My true Guru is ever merciful; he saved me, poor as I was.
ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ. ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He put God's life-giving Name in my mouth; my sickness was cut away and I found great bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ. ਪਰਹਰਿਆ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ. ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
The Guru has taken away my many sins and cut my bonds; I am set free.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
Taking me by the arm, the Guru pulled me out of the pitch-dark well. ॥2॥
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ. ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
I have become free of fear, every fear is gone; the Protector has protected me.
ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Such is Your gift, my God, that all my tasks are accomplished. ॥3॥
The Master, treasure of virtues, has met me within my mind.
Since I took His refuge, O Nanak, I am at ease. ॥4॥9॥48॥
ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ. ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ; ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
When I forget You, everyone seems my enemy; when You come to mind, all show me honour.
ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
O eternal, unseen, unfathomable Lord, I see no other equal to You. ॥1॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
One in whose mind God dwells finds Him ever merciful; what can poor people do to him?
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ. ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Tell me, whom can one call bad or good? All beings are Yours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ. ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ; ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ. ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
You are my shelter and my support; giving Your hand, You protect us.
ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ. ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ. ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
The person on whom Your grace rests, no one speaks ill of him. ॥2॥
ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Whatever pleases God's mind, that is my comfort and my honour.
ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
You are the Knower of hearts, ever merciful; when I receive the Name I enjoy delight. ॥3॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
My prayer is before You: this soul and body are all Your gift.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ. ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
Says Nanak: all honour is Your gift; otherwise no one would even know my name. ॥4॥10॥49॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
O God, Knower of hearts, be gracious; in the company of the holy God is found.
ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਪੁਨਰਪਿ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
He opens the doors and shows His sight, and one does not come into birth again. ॥1॥
ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
May I meet my beloved Master and rid myself of all sorrows.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the company of one who has worshipped the Supreme Lord in his heart, may I too cross over. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ. ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ; ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
Apart from God the world becomes a vast wilderness and a sea of fire; one lives now in joy, now in sorrow.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Meeting the true Guru and repeating God's life-giving Name with the tongue, the mind becomes pure. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
Taking body and wealth to be all their own, people are tied by the sweet bonds of attachment;
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
by the Guru's grace those servants are freed who worship God's Name. ॥3॥
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
The protecting God has saved those who are pleasing to Him.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
O Giver, soul and body are all Yours; Nanak is ever a sacrifice to You. ॥4॥11॥50॥
ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ. ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ; ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
O friend, you are free of attachment's sleep that soils the mind; what grace has come to you?
ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ. ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ; ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Maya, the great enticer, does not grip you; where has your sloth gone? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
384: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ; ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ. ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
Lust, anger and pride are hard to bear; by what discipline were you freed of them?
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ, ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ; ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Good men, gods, demons, all beings of the three qualities: they have plundered the whole world. ॥1॥
ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ; ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
When the forest fire burns much grass, only a rare green plant survives.
ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ. ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ. ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
I cannot describe such a mighty one; his likeness cannot be told. ॥2॥
ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ, ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ. ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
In the soot-filled chamber I did not turn black; my pure colour stayed,
ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ, ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ; ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
for the Guru's great mantra dwells in my heart and I listen to the wondrous Name. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ; ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
In His grace God looked on me with His glance and kept me attached to His feet.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
Through loving devotion, O Nanak, I found bliss and stay merged in the company of the holy. ॥4॥12॥51॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The red robe looks lovely on your body.
You are pleasing to the Friend, and so you have won my heart too. ॥1॥
O sister, how did your redness come about?
ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ; ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through what dye have you become so deep a crimson? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You look truly beautiful; your married fortune has shone forth.
ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ; ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
The Beloved has come into your heart; in your heart fortune has awoken. ॥2॥
You have become pure of conduct, and you are honoured everywhere.
ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ; ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
You are pleasing to the Beloved, and you have become one of noble understanding. ॥3॥
I have become pleasing to the Beloved, and so I am dyed in deep love.
Says Nanak: He looks on me with a gracious glance. ॥4॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ; ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
Listen, O friend, this is the only labour I did:
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ, ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
God, the Giver of beauty, adorned me Himself. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥1॥52॥
O friend, when I was far from God's feet, I suffered great pain.
Now through the Guru's teaching I have reached His presence. ॥1॥
O friend, O companion, my complaining is over.
ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My wandering has gone; the Guru has united me with my Husband Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Bringing me close, the Guru seated me on my Beloved's bed;
I am freed from depending on anyone else. ॥2॥
Through the Guru's word there is light in the temple of my heart.
My Master, Lord of all joys and wonders, has met me. ॥3॥
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਮੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
The fortune on my forehead has awoken, for my Husband has come into my home;
O servant Nanak, I have found the lasting married state. ॥4॥2॥53॥
My mind is attached to the eternal Name;
with people my dealings go only as far as need requires. ॥1॥
Outwardly I keep loving ties with all,
ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
yet I stay detached, like the lotus in water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ; ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
I talk with everyone with my mouth,
but keep my God alone in my heart. ॥2॥
To people my mind looks very harsh and dry,
ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
yet this mind is the dust of everyone's feet. ॥3॥
O Nanak, whoever has found the perfect Guru,
385: The Guru has shown him the one God dwelling within him and outside in all the world. ॥4॥3॥54॥
While youth gives a person bodily strength, he goes on revelling carefree,
but the body at last mixes with the dust, and without the Name the soul is left empty-handed. ॥1॥
A person puts gold rings in his ears and wears fine clothes,
sleeps on soft beds, and takes pride in his mind over these comforts. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Even if he has an elephant beneath him and a golden canopy over his head,
ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ; ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
the body is still laid in the earth at last, and he stays bereft of devotion to God. ॥2॥
Even if he has many women of beautiful form, what of it?
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Beside the taste of God's Name, all these worldly tastes are insipid. ॥3॥
Remember that Maya is a cheat, and worldly vices are full of poison.
O Nanak, say: O God, O merciful Lord, I have come to Your refuge. ॥4॥4॥55॥
This world is one garden, in which the Gardener has planted countless plants.
Those within whom the Name-water that gives spiritual life flows bear the fruit of a high spiritual life. ॥1॥
O man of wisdom, reflect in such a way
that you reach the state which no craving can touch.
ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ; ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All around you flow springs of poison, but within you is the nectar, O brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Keep in your heart the one Gardener who waters them,
ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
who takes care of every leaf and every branch. ॥2॥
He has brought all the vegetation and set it out to adorn this garden.
All of it is in flower; no plant is without fruit. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
But one who has received from the Guru the fruit of the Name that gives spiritual life,
O servant Nanak, say: he has crossed the river of Maya. ॥4॥5॥56॥
O God, Your Name has made for me the delight that kings seem to find in their kingdom,
and when I sing Your praises I attain the yoga of the yogis. ॥1॥
O God, resting on Your support, every comfort has come to me,
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
since the true Guru drew aside the veils that breed wandering. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Understanding Your will, I enjoy every spiritual delight;
through the service the true Guru taught, I have reached the highest state free of craving. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Whoever has come to know You deeply is accepted, whether householder or renunciate;
only one dyed in Your Name stays free of worldly cravings. ॥3॥
O God, one who has received the treasure of Your Name,
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
Says Nanak: his treasure of virtues stays ever full. ॥4॥6॥57॥
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
If I go to a place of pilgrimage, I see people there saying, I am righteous, I am righteous;
if I ask the pandits, they too are dyed in Maya. ॥1॥
O friend, show me that place
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where God's praises are sung at all times. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Shastras and Vedas only set out thoughts on sin and merit,
by which one falls again and again, now into hell, now into heaven. ॥2॥
Householders are weighed down by anxiety, and renunciates are swollen with pride;
the souls of those who perform rituals are caught in Maya's tangles. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
One whose mind comes under control by God's grace,
O Nanak, say: he has crossed Maya by taking the Guru's refuge. ॥4॥
In the company of the holy, God's praises should always be sung;
ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
but this place is found through the Guru. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥7॥58॥
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
One who remembers God feels bliss within his heart, and bliss outside too in his dealings with the world,
for in remembering God all sorrows are destroyed. ॥1॥
ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ; ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
O God, one in whose mind You come to dwell feels every comfort.
386: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ; ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
But only the one who is pleasing to You repeats Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
O God, by repeating Your Name the mind grows calm, and the body grows calm too.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ; ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
As God's Name is repeated, sorrows strike their camp and leave. ॥2॥
One who understands God's will is accepted,
for he carries the pass of the word of praise of the eternal Lord. ॥3॥
The perfect Guru has fixed God's Name firmly in my heart.
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
Says Nanak: since then my mind has known only peace. ॥4॥8॥59॥
O Lord, wherever You send me, there I go gladly;
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
whatever You give me, I take it as comfort. ॥1॥
O Govind, O Master, may I ever remain Your servant,
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈਁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for by Your grace I stay fully sated of the thirst for Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O God, what You give me I wear and eat with contentment,
and by Your grace, O God, I pass my life in peace. ॥2॥
O God, within my mind and heart I remember only You;
I hold no one equal to You. ॥3॥
O Nanak, say: may I ever remember You in this way,
and gain the high spiritual state by falling at the feet of Your saints. ॥4॥9॥60॥
Rising, sitting and sleeping, God should be remembered;
walking on the road too, God's praises should be sung. ॥1॥
With the ears, the praise of God that gives spiritual life should be heard,
ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
hearing which bliss rises in the mind and all the mind's sorrows and ills depart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At every task and work, on the road and at the ford, the Name should be repeated,
and by the Guru's grace God's life-giving Name should be drunk. ॥2॥
Day and night the song of God's praises should be sung.
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Spiritual death does not come near such a person on life's journey. ॥3॥
O God, the one who never forgets You through all eight watches,
ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
O Nanak, say: by falling at his feet others too gain the high spiritual state. ॥4॥10॥61॥
Remember God, by whose remembrance peace comes to dwell in the mind,
well-being lasts and sorrows are destroyed. ॥1॥
ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Enjoy spiritual bliss and sing God's praises;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
keep winning the favour of your true Guru for ever and ever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Keep the true Guru's word of praise of the eternal Lord in your heart and shape your life by it;
ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
you will stay steady in your own heart and find your God within. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ; ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
Never think ill of anyone in your mind,
ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ; ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
and no sorrow will touch you, O brother, O friend. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
One to whom the Guru has given God's Name as his charm and his mantra,
O Nanak, recognises this bliss dwelling within him at all times. ॥4॥11॥62॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ; ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
O God, one whom no one even knows, taking him to be of low caste,
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
is honoured in all four directions by repeating Your Name. ॥1॥
O beloved God, I beg for the sight of You; grant it to me.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ. ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever has served You, You have carried across the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
One whom no one would even approach
ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
now has his feet washed by the whole world, rubbing them clean. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਕਾਹੂ. ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
One who was of no use to anyone
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
is, by the Guru's grace, now remembered everywhere. ॥3॥
O mind, in the company of the holy those asleep wake up,
O Nanak, say: and then God becomes dear to them. ॥4॥12॥63॥
With my eyes I see the one God alone dwelling everywhere,
and ever keep God's Name in my heart. ॥1॥
387: I keep singing the lovely virtues of God;
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ. ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by the glory the Guru gives, in the Guru's company, I ever meditate on God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
The One on the thread of whose will all things are strung
In an instant God can create and destroy the whole world,
yet He Himself stays apart, untouched by the three qualities of Maya. ॥3॥
God, the knower of every heart, can do all and have all done;
and Nanak's Lord remains ever joyful. ॥4॥13॥64॥
Those who gain the dust of the saints' feet have ended their rounds of millions of births;
they have won the game of this hard-won human birth and not lost it. ॥1॥
Their sins are destroyed and their sorrows and pains are gone;
ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they become pure, who receive the dust of the saints' feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God's saints have the power to save others from vices,
but they meet only one in whose destiny union is written from the beginning. ॥2॥
One to whom the Guru has given his teaching has bliss in his mind;
his thirst is quenched and his mind stops wavering. ॥3॥
He gains the treasure of the Name, as if the nine treasures and the miraculous powers too,
O Nanak, the one who has gained true understanding from the Guru. ॥4॥14॥65॥
The thirst for Maya born of the darkness of ignorance is wiped out,
and through the service the Guru taught many sins are cut away. ॥1॥
They find great peace and bliss, and stillness of mind stays with them;
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by serving the Guru their minds become pure, those who ever hear God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The foolishness and stubbornness of the mind are destroyed,
and God's will comes to seem sweet. ॥2॥
Those who have grasped the feet of the perfect Guru
have the sins of millions of births washed away. ॥3॥
This precious human birth becomes fruitful;
Says Nanak: it is so for those on whom God has shown mercy. ॥4॥15॥66॥
O mind, keep your true Guru in your heart for ever and ever.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Dust the Guru's feet with your hair. ॥1॥
Wake up, O mind that is able to wake;
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ; ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without God nothing else will be of use to you; attachment and the spread of Maya stay with no one. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Bind your love to the Guru's word.
When the Guru is kind, every sorrow goes. ॥2॥
Apart from the Guru there is no other place where the sleeping mind can be woken.
The Guru is the giver; the Guru gives the Name. ॥3॥
The Guru is the form of the supreme Lord, the form of the transcendent God Himself.
O Nanak, keep the Guru in mind all eight watches. ॥4॥16॥67॥
God Himself is the trunk, and the world is the spread of its branches.
This world is His own crop, and He Himself guards it. ॥1॥
Wherever I look I see only the One;
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He Himself dwells within every body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is the sun, and the world is the spread of His rays;
He is the unseen and He is the visible form. ॥2॥
He Himself gives the names "without attributes" and "with attributes";
the two together have their one abode in Him. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whose wandering and fear the Guru has removed
has seen with his own eyes the ever-blissful Lord everywhere. ॥4॥17॥68॥
O God, I know no argument and no clever speech;
388: day and night I utter Your Name. ॥1॥
O God, I am without virtue; I have no virtue at all,
but it is You who can do all and have all done. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I am foolish, dull, ignorant and without discernment;
ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
I hold in my mind hope in Your Name. ॥2॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
I have practised no chanting, no austerity, no self-discipline;
I only keep remembering God's Name in my mind. ॥3॥
ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
I know nothing; my understanding is small.
Nanak prays: O God, I have taken only Your support. ॥4॥18॥69॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ; ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
My rosary is these two words, Har Har;
as it is repeated again and again, God becomes kind even to the poor. ॥1॥
O true Guru, I make this prayer of mine to you:
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ, ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
be gracious and keep me in your refuge, and give me the rosary of God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who keeps God's rosary within his heart
rids himself of the pain of birth and death. ॥2॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ; ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
One who cherishes God in his heart and utters God's Name with his mouth
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ; ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
does not waver anywhere, here or hereafter. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: one who stays absorbed in the Name,
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who stays the servant of the One to whom all this belongs,
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ; ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
no influence of Maya can touch that person. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
God's servant is ever free of the bonds of attachment;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whatever He does seems good to His servant, and the servant's way of life is utterly pure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who leaves all other supports and comes to God's refuge,
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
One in whose mind the treasure of the Name dwells,
no anxiety touches him even in dreams. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: one who has found the perfect Guru
has all his wandering and attachment destroyed. ॥4॥20॥71॥
When my God is greatly pleased with a person,
ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ; ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
then tell me, how can sorrow or wandering come near him? ॥1॥
Hearing Your glory again and again, spiritual life rises in me.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ; ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Save me, who am without virtue. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Every sorrow has gone from me, and I have forgotten all anxiety;
I have gained this fruit by repeating the true Guru's word. ॥2॥
He alone is eternal, He alone is ever lasting;
remember Him again and again and keep Him strung around your neck. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: what other religious deed is left
for one in whose mind God's Name has come to dwell? ॥4॥21॥72॥
People gripped by Maya are ruined in lust, anger and pride;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
God's servants are saved by remembering God. ॥1॥
Drunk on the wine of Maya, people stay asleep;
ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the devotees stay awake, dyed in God as they remember Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the wandering of attachment, people are made to roam through many births;
the devotees, meditating on God's feet, stay steady. ॥2॥
From the bonds of the blind well of "this house is mine"
the saints are free, who know God to be near. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: one who stays in God's refuge
has peace here and the high spiritual state hereafter. ॥4॥22॥73॥
389: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ; ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, You are my river and I am Your fish;
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
You are my Master and I lie at Your door. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ; ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
You are my Creator and I am Your servant;
ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O God, deep ocean of virtues, I have taken Your refuge. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are my life, You are my support;
seeing You, my heart blooms like the lotus. ॥2॥
ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ; ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
You are my high spiritual state and my honour; whatever You do I accept gladly.
You are all-powerful; You alone are my strength. ॥3॥
O treasure of virtues, may I repeat Your Name day and night;
this is Nanak's prayer to God. ॥4॥23॥74॥
The one who weeps for the dead weeps falsely, for his own troubles;
the stranger who comes to mourn mourns with laughter. ॥1॥
ਕੋ ਮੂਆ; ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
Someone dies, and in someone's house there is singing;
ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ; ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
someone weeps and someone bursts out laughing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
a person barely reaches the next stage before giving up hope, and then he regrets. ॥2॥
The world runs about under the three qualities of Maya,
falling again and again, now into the hell of sorrow, now into the heaven of pleasure. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: one whom God joins to His Name,
his human birth is fruitful and accepted. ॥4॥24॥75॥
ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
O friend, the soul-bride who stays asleep does not grasp any teaching of God;
when the dawn comes, she regrets. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
O friend, through love of the Beloved I rest in stillness of mind and keep bliss in my heart;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ; ਤਾ ਤੇ. ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the longing to meet God is in me, so how can I be idle? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O friend, God brought the life-giving water of the Name and poured it into our hands,
but it slips from her hands and falls into the dust. ॥2॥
The soul-bride is weighed down by the taste of things, by attachment and by pride;
no blame lies on God the Creator. ॥3॥
One whose darkness of wandering is dispelled in the company of the holy,
O Nanak, the Creator unites with Himself. ॥4॥25॥76॥
O beloved God, one in whom hope of Your lotus feet arises,
from him the wretched messengers of death flee. ॥1॥
You come into the mind of one on whom Your mercy falls,
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ; ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and remembering Your Name, all his ills are destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
To others they give many kinds of pain,
ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ; ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
but they cannot come near Your servant. ॥2॥
ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One whose mind is touched with thirst for the sight of You
dwells detached from Maya in the bliss of stillness of mind. ॥3॥
grant him only Your Name to keep in his heart. ॥4॥26॥77॥
That person's mind is sated and his entanglements are ended,
on whom his own God becomes kind. ॥1॥
By the Guru's grace my fortune has awoken;
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ; ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have met the fearless Master in whose house everything is in full. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One in whose heart the merciful Guru has fixed the Name
is rid of the terrible hunger for Maya. ॥2॥
One to whom the Lord has given His gift
has the burning quenched and peace in his mind. ॥3॥
ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ; ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
His search has ended and his mind has settled in stillness of mind,
390: O Nanak, he has found the treasure of God's Name. ॥4॥27॥78॥
ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
One whose love for the Master is made firm
stays sated, through the food of the Name that never runs out. ॥1॥
ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ; ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they use the treasure and share it, enjoy it and can give joy to others. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One whose protector is the unreachable Master of the world,
say, what power can any person have over him? ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
He by whose service all eighteen powers of miracle are gained,
ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
by whose glance of grace all this comes: stay ever at His feet. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
O my Master, those on whom You show mercy,
Says Nanak: they lack nothing at all. ॥4॥28॥79॥
Since I have enshrined my true Guru in my mind,
ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
my mind has found great joy. ॥1॥
Every worry of theirs is wiped out, every dread removed,
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ; ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who are dyed in the Name; they become fortunate. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Since I have held my Master in my heart,
O my friend, every fear of mine has gone. ॥2॥
ਜਉ ਮੈ; ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
O God, since I have taken Your shelter,
every wish of my mind is being fulfilled. ॥3॥
Seeing Your wondrous deeds, my mind grows in reassurance.
O Nanak, I, Your servant, rely on You alone. ॥4॥29॥80॥
Day after day the mouse gnaws at the rope you hang by;
fallen in the well, you go on eating sweets. ॥1॥
The whole night of life passes in thinking thoughts of Maya;
ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
a person dwells on Maya's many shows and never remembers God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
He takes the shade of a tree to be a lasting home;
ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ; ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
he is caught in the noose of spiritual death, and Maya has drawn her sharp arrow. ॥2॥
The world is a sandy bank in the mouth of the waves,
ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ; ਮੂੜਿ. ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
yet the fool has taken this place to be lasting. ॥3॥
One who has repeated the Name of the Lord King in the company of the holy,
O Nanak, gains spiritual life by singing God's praises. ॥4॥30॥81॥
ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
O body, in the soul's company you play many games;
ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
in its company you stay joined with everyone;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
in its company everyone longs to meet you;
ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੋਊ. ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
without the soul, no one will so much as face you. ॥1॥
There is no knowing where that soul goes once it turns away from you.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O body, without it you are left in misery. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
O body, while the soul was with you, you were counted wise in the house;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
with the soul, you are known everywhere;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
with the soul, you are nurtured and kept.
Without it, you are cast off and left to rot. ॥2॥
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
O body, with the soul you have honour and respect;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
with the soul, you are given greatness, and the world seems your kin;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
with the soul, you are cared for in every way.
ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ; ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
Parted from it, you are left in the dust. ॥3॥
The soul that turns away and leaves neither dies nor is born;
